rows.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE i.institution_type != '' AND i.institution_country != '' GROUP BY inst_type, country_family

SELECT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS disease_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN d.id END) AS infectious_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN d.id END) AS oral_treatment_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_country != '' GROUP BY country_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS institution_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(treatments) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'uses_injection' WHEN treatments != '' THEN 'no_injection' END AS treatment_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease WHERE treatments != '' GROUP BY treatment_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS institution_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnostic_methods != '' THEN d.id END) AS dx_recorded_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.prognosis != '' THEN d.id END) AS prognosis_recorded_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(diagnostic_methods) LIKE '%laboratory_test%' THEN 'lab_test' WHEN diagnostic_methods != '' THEN 'other_methods' END AS dx_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oral_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(treatments) LIKE '%surgery%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surgery_count FROM disease WHERE diagnostic_methods != '' GROUP BY dx_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN dr.id END) AS rx_only_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.treatments != '' THEN d.id END) AS treatment_recorded_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(quality_of_life_impact) LIKE '%quality_of_life_decline%' THEN 'qol_decline' WHEN quality_of_life_impact != '' THEN 'other_impact' END AS qol_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease WHERE quality_of_life_impact != '' GROUP BY qol_group

SELECT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_country != '' GROUP BY country_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN 'oral_medication' ELSE 'other_treatment' END AS treatment_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease d WHERE d.disease_type != '' AND d.treatments != '' GROUP BY type_family, treatment_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.manufacturer != '' AND dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%oncology%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%neuroscience%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%immunology%' OR LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%microbiology%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%clinical_research%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.research_fields != '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.research_fields != '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.disease_type != '' AND dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY type_family, route_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%oncology%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%neuroscience%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%immunology%' OR LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%microbiology%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%clinical_research%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.research_fields != '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS institution_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usa_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.funding_sources != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS funding_count FROM institution i WHERE i.research_fields != '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(prognosis) LIKE '%high_mortality%' THEN 'high_mortality' WHEN LOWER(prognosis) LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS prognosis_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(treatments) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS injection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN quality_of_life_impact != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qol_recorded_count FROM disease WHERE prognosis != '' GROUP BY prognosis_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN 'oral_treatment_disease' ELSE 'other_treatment_disease' END AS treatment_group, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.treatments != '' GROUP BY treatment_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%oncology%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%neuroscience%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%immunology%' OR LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%microbiology%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%clinical_research%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.research_fields != '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE i.research_fields != '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease d WHERE LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(*) AS drug_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rx_only_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.storage_conditions) LIKE '%room temperature%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS room_temp_count FROM drug dr WHERE dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY route_family

SELECT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS disease_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_country != '' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY country_family, type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.pathogenesis) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious_pathogenesis' WHEN d.pathogenesis != '' THEN 'other_pathogenesis' END AS path_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease d WHERE d.disease_type != '' AND d.pathogenesis != '' GROUP BY type_family, path_group

SELECT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_country != '' AND dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY country_family, route_family
SELECT CASE WHEN funding_sources != '' THEN 'funding_recorded' ELSE 'funding_unknown' END AS funding_status, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution GROUP BY funding_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS institution_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' AND dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.diagnostic_methods) LIKE '%clinical_evaluation%' THEN 'clinical_evaluation' ELSE 'other_methods' END AS dx_group, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS disease_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.diagnostic_methods != '' GROUP BY dx_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(diagnostic_methods) LIKE '%clinical_evaluation%' THEN 'clinical_evaluation' ELSE 'other_methods' END AS dx_group, CASE WHEN LOWER(prognosis) LIKE '%high_mortality%' THEN 'high_mortality' WHEN prognosis != '' THEN 'other_prognosis' END AS prognosis_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease WHERE diagnostic_methods != '' AND prognosis != '' GROUP BY dx_group, prognosis_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN 'oral_treatment_disease' ELSE 'other_treatment_disease' END AS treatment_group, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' AND d.treatments != '' GROUP BY form_family, treatment_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' AND dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY route_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.diagnostic_methods) LIKE '%imaging%' THEN 'uses_imaging' WHEN d.diagnostic_methods != '' THEN 'no_imaging' END AS imaging_status, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS disease_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_type != '' AND d.diagnostic_methods != '' GROUP BY inst_type, imaging_status

SELECT CASE WHEN prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 'prescription_only' ELSE 'other' END AS rx_status, CASE WHEN LOWER(storage_conditions) LIKE '%room temperature%' THEN 'room_temperature' ELSE 'other_storage' END AS storage_group, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE prescription_status != '' AND storage_conditions != '' GROUP BY rx_status, storage_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.manufacturer != '' THEN dr.id END) AS known_mfr_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.administration_route != '' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY route_family, type_family HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) >= 2

SELECT CASE WHEN international_collaboration != '' THEN 'has_collaboration' ELSE 'no_collaboration_recorded' END AS collab_status, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution GROUP BY collab_status

SELECT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE i.institution_country != '' GROUP BY country_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' AND i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form <> '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE dr.dosage_frequency <> '' AND dr.pharmaceutical_form <> '' GROUP BY form_family
SELECT CASE WHEN key_technologies <> '' THEN 'funding_recorded' ELSE 'funding_unknown' END AS funding_status, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution GROUP BY funding_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%oncology%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%neuroscience%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%immunology%' OR LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%microbiology%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%clinical_research%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.research_fields <> '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN i.funding_sources LIKE '%government%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.funding_sources <> '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution AS i WHERE i.research_fields <> '' AND i.funding_sources <> '' GROUP BY field_family, country_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.unsuitable_population) LIKE '%patients%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.unsuitable_population) LIKE '%allergic%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.unsuitable_population) LIKE '%allergy%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.unsuitable_population <> '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE dr.unsuitable_population <> '' GROUP BY form_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route <> '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN dr.id END) AS infectious_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.unsuitable_population LIKE '%patients%' THEN dr.id END) AS rx_only_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE dr.administration_route <> '' GROUP BY route_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route <> '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type <> '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.dosage_frequency <> '' THEN dr.id END) AS known_mfr_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE dr.administration_route <> '' AND d.disease_type <> '' GROUP BY route_family, type_family HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) >= 2

SELECT CASE WHEN activation_conditions LIKE '%special%' THEN 'prescription_only' WHEN activation_conditions <> '' THEN 'other' END AS rx_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE activation_conditions <> '' GROUP BY rx_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_name) LIKE '%massachusetts%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_name) LIKE '%microbiome%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_name) LIKE '%adventhealth%' OR LOWER(i.institution_name) LIKE '%allegiance%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_name) LIKE '%institute%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.institution_name <> '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN 'oral_treatment' ELSE 'other_treatment' END AS treatment_group, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS disease_count FROM institution AS i JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE i.institution_name <> '' AND d.treatments <> '' GROUP BY field_family, treatment_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type <> '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(*) AS disease_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(d.common_symptoms) LIKE '%yellow%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oral_treatment_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(d.diagnostic_methods) LIKE '%clinical_evaluation%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clinical_dx_count FROM disease AS d WHERE d.disease_type <> '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatment_challenges) LIKE '%side%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.treatment_challenges) LIKE '%late%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.treatment_challenges) LIKE '%current%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.treatment_challenges) LIKE '%difficult%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.treatment_challenges <> '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') JOIN institution AS i ON (LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE d.treatment_challenges <> '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.dosage_frequency) LIKE '%once%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.dosage_frequency) LIKE '%twice%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.dosage_frequency) LIKE '%every%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.dosage_frequency <> '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%oncology%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%neuroscience%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%immunology%' OR LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%microbiology%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%clinical_research%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.research_fields <> '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') JOIN institution AS i ON (LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE dr.dosage_frequency <> '' AND i.research_fields <> '' GROUP BY form_family, field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type <> '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.brand_name) LIKE '%savella%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.brand_name) LIKE '%aplactin%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.brand_name) LIKE '%abreva%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.brand_name <> '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE d.disease_type <> '' AND dr.brand_name <> '' GROUP BY type_family, form_family
SELECT CASE WHEN single_dose <> '' THEN 'mechanism_recorded' ELSE 'mechanism_unknown' END AS moa_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug GROUP BY moa_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.etiology) LIKE '%astrazeneca%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.etiology) LIKE '%clinical%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.etiology) LIKE '%hmbs%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.etiology) LIKE '%infected%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.etiology <> '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS institution_count FROM institution AS i JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE d.etiology <> '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country <> '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.single_dose) LIKE '%adults%' THEN dr.id END) AS oral_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN dr.id END) AS tablet_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') JOIN institution AS i ON (LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE i.institution_country <> '' GROUP BY country_family
